name: com.viol3.texturepixelizer
description: Editor tool that bakes a dithered pixel-art look into material textures. Non-destructive: the original texture is kept, the result is saved as <name>_pixelated.png. Fully scriptable: one-call C# API (PixelizerApi) and a batch-mode entry point, so it can be driven by scripts and AI coding agents. See AGENTS.md.
